other_conditions: Must be a native of Bihar.
Must belong to a minority community.
Must be enrolled in a recognized institution, school, college, university, or technical institution in their respective district.
Must be pursuing a course recognized by the Government.
Must reside in a hostel operated by the Minority Welfare Department, Government of Bihar.
benefits_summary: Monthly stipend of ₹1,000 along with essential hostel facilities and a monthly allocation of 9 kg rice and 6 kg wheat.
